newsitem.title: USA: Kmart says Floto to leave for other firm.
newsitem.headline: Kmart says Floto to leave for other firm.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Tuesday that Ronald Floto, executive vice president, Kmart Corp and president, Super Kmart Centers, has decided to accept a job with an unidentified international company.
He will leave Kmart effective May 5, 1997.
On an interim basis, the Super Kmart division will report directly to Floyd Hall, Kmart's chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Ernest Heether, senior vice president, merchandise planning and replenishment, will assume duties for Kmart's distribution centers which also reported to Floto.
Hall said Floto has made contributions that stretch beyond the Super Kmart Center organization.
"He has put a first-rate management team in place that will be instrumental as we grow and further improve this important division of our business," Hall said.
Floto joined Kmart in October 1994 after serving as chairman, chief executive officer and president of Kash n' Karry Food Stores Inc KASH.O.
Kmart operates 2,036 Kmart stores and 97 Super Kmart Centers.
